name: ns_proofsearch_signed_leray_escape_coordinate
rubric_version_reason: Successor after Phase 5DX-5EB: exact pressure-aware Leray intertwiners produce a real signed local signal, but PSD completion and viscous lifetime block naive promotion.
description: Focused theorem-search substrate for promoting or killing a signed pressure-aware Leray escape coordinate as a Navier-Stokes middle-layer bridge.

cage_meta.class_reason: Qualitative theorem-search over an exact signed-coordinate bridge, not numerical curve fitting.

disable_uniqueness_gap_gate_reason: Rivals are adjudicated by admissibility, damping, PSD, and cycle-transfer gates.
persona: You are a ruthless PDE theorem-search referee in Newton mode. The exact local audits found a real pressure-aware signed Leray-intertwiner signal, but positive-energy ballast and viscous lifetime currently kill naive promotion. Reward only a theorem packet or no-go that handles independent orientation, pressure-aware admissibility, residual-defect transfer, PSD honesty, viscous/Duhamel damping, high-high or multi-background stress, and cycle/critical-norm transfer. Penalize arbitrary Leray smuggling, positive-energy laundering, absolute-value orientation after seeing gamma, metric-kernel substitution, finite-to-infinite supremum induction, weak-solution overclaims, and unbounded computation.

dimensions.name: Independent Signed Coordinate
dimensions.description: Is the signed coordinate, support rule, matrix family, and orientation defined independently of residual/profit outcomes?

dimensions.name: Pressure-Aware Admissibility
dimensions.description: Does the thesis justify or tax use of P_r M P_s rather than treating Leray access as free?

dimensions.name: Orientation Non-Tautology
dimensions.description: Does the sign/orientation rule avoid absolute-value hindsight and phase-fitting?

dimensions.name: Residual-Defect Ledger
dimensions.description: Does the packet report mixed residual, projected defect, and transfer conditions?

dimensions.name: PSD And Ballast Honesty
dimensions.description: Does it distinguish signed coordinate from positive energy and pay diagonal ballast if claiming positivity?

dimensions.name: Viscous Lifetime Discipline
dimensions.description: Does it pay source/output damping or provide a theorem showing the Phase 5EB damping proxy is not the right tax?

dimensions.name: High-High And Multi-Background Stress
dimensions.description: Does it survive or explicitly fail self-interaction and two-background stress?

dimensions.name: Cycle Or Critical-Norm Transfer
dimensions.description: Does it connect the signed coordinate to a danger-reset-return cycle, critical norm, or smooth-data realization?

dimensions.name: Generative Yield
dimensions.description: Does it produce a theorem packet, exact falsifier, new CAS/Lean-facing target, or decisive proof-cost reranking?

dimensions.name: Scope Honesty And Resource Safety
dimensions.description: Does it avoid Clay overclaim and keep proposed audits bounded, sparse, symbolic, or proof-facing?

criteria.Independent_Signed_Coordinate: Full credit requires a predeclared signed coordinate, matrix family, support rule, and locality rule. Score zero for choosing M, phases, signs, or amplitudes from the desired margin.
criteria.Pressure_Aware_Admissibility: Full credit requires a PDE-side admissibility mechanism or explicit tax for P_r M P_s. Merely commuting with Leray is insufficient.
criteria.Orientation_Non_Tautology: Full credit requires a non-circular sign/orientation rule. Absolute value of gamma is only an optimistic diagnostic, not a theorem.
criteria.Residual_Defect_Ledger: Full credit requires signed response and projected residual/defect to be reported together with a transfer condition.
criteria.PSD_And_Ballast_Honesty: Full credit requires either explicit signed-coordinate nonclaim or diagonal ballast payment for any positive-energy claim.
criteria.Viscous_Lifetime_Discipline: Full credit requires source/output damping, Duhamel lifetime, or a proof that the local damping proxy is inapplicable.
criteria.High_High_And_Multi_Background_Stress: Full credit requires self-interaction or multi-background stress accounting.
criteria.Cycle_Or_Critical_Norm_Transfer: Full credit requires a bridge to cycle margin, return-time geometry, critical norm, or smooth-data realization.
criteria.Generative_Yield: Full credit requires a usable theorem/falsifier packet or decisive route reranking.
criteria.Scope_Honesty_And_Resource_Safety: Reject unsupported regularity/blowup claims and unbounded dense computation proposals.

success_criteria: A positive signed-coordinate bridge satisfying admissibility, orientation, residual-defect, damping, and cycle/critical-norm transfer.
A no-go theorem proving that admissible pressure-aware intertwiners cannot promote beyond signed local signal after ballast/damping/transfer costs.
A bounded exact Fourier/CAS falsifier that kills the live signed-coordinate class and names the next theorem target.
failure_modes: Choosing orientation, phases, amplitudes, or M by solving backward from positive gamma.
Calling an indefinite signed coordinate a positive energy without ballast.
Treating P_r M P_s as admissible merely because it commutes with Leray.
Ignoring viscous damping or Duhamel lifetime.
Defining cycle variables from observed gain/loss.
Substituting a metric kernel for Euclidean pressure/Leray.
Inferring a Clay result from a local bounded Fourier signal.
Using large dense Fourier jobs, unbounded Lean builds, or the crashed exponential metric transport obstruction.
